name: [🎃] Marble DUELS 🔮
description:
Marble DUELS! Flick your marble, knock marbles out of the ring and keep every one you capture. 1v1 PvP or vs bots!

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT: the Jack-o'-Marble LIMITED is in Marble Bags. Only 1,000 will ever exist, each one serial numbered!

⚔️ 1v1 DUELS against players on your server
🤖 Play vs bots: 8 levels from Rookie to Legend
🏰 THE TOWER: 8 floors on 6 fields, then the Black Taw boss
🔮 Collect marbles: Ember, Volt, Nova, Obsidian, Ruby Heart and more
💎 LIMITED marbles with serial numbers: Aurora (500), Comet (1,500), Jack-o'-Marble (1,000)
🎒 Marble Bags with every drop rate shown in the shop
🏆 Global leaderboard, 5 badges, daily reward streak
👑 VIP: 2x coins, the Golden Taw and a VIP chat tag
⭐ Roblox Premium: free Prism marble and +25% coins

🕹️ Controls: press, pull back and let go. Phone, tablet and PC.

📜 Updates
28 Oct 2026: Halloween event, Jack-o'-Marble Limited, pumpkins in the lobby.

Like 👍 and favourite ⭐ for new marbles and fields every update!
